snippet.title: Military Incremental Complex - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Military Incremental Complex launches November 21st!!

✅ - Wishlist it on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469750/Military_Incremental_Complex/

💬 - Join the Discord - https://discord.gg/unp9BR69cA
📧 - Signup for the email list - https://spacekrakenstudios.substack.com/

Make weapons, make money.
Start your own military industrial complex enterprise! Begin by making bullets by hand, then with machines, then acquire entire factories. Expand into making guns, tanks, planes, and even nukes. Research new products, faster and cheaper ways to make them, and better methods of making money. Enter the stock market to earn passive dividends, unlock tiered upgrades, and boost your production. Lobby the government for fewer regulations, better contracts, and more demand for your products. Turn the entire economy into a weapons making machine, making you ludicrous amounts of money!
